specs.title: every public page renders without console errors, overflow or broken internal links
landing: hero, real replay, evidence, limitations and FAQ
header navigation marks the active route; mobile menu opens, closes on Escape and returns focus
reduced motion: content is visible immediately and nothing is left hidden
structured replay flow produces one card, history, scenario and sources
sources: card list with expandable detail on phones, table from tablet width
missing turnover is shown as unavailable, never as a number
unknown underlying anchor is labeled UNKNOWN and disables the stock-linked scenario
stale observation is labeled stale with its age

form confirmation: research stays blocked until confirmed, and any edit clears the confirmation
natural-language flow: extract, confirm, research and grounded explanation
missing limit and ambiguous inputs block confirmation with clear messages
provider failure and live outside-session states are explained
keyboard: skip link, CTA focus ring, and desk controls reachable
method page shows coverage for all candidates and every anchored section
metadata: title, description, social tags, icon and theme color on every public page; no localhost URLs
desk at 1440/1280/1024/768/390: decision lands in view after a run, no overflow, 44px targets
the decision card renders the computed action, not a fixed STAND DOWN
